changeSet.author: beefcare

preConditions.onFailMessage: Refusing to drop herd draft tables containing data. Back up and migrate the data in place before upgrading; disposable development databases may be explicitly reset.

or.sqlCheck: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DATABASECHANGELOG WHERE ID = '20261028000001-drop-draft-tables' AND AUTHOR = 'beefcare'

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pen_reception_criteria) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pen_assignment) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cattle_qr_tag) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM herd_entry) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM herd_exit) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cattle_profile_change) + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM record_revision)

changeSet.comment: Refuse to run the legacy destructive draft-table migration when it could remove data. Back up and migrate nonempty draft data in place before applying this release.
